hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'bazel' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE '\bclean\b' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'expunge'; then jq -n --arg cmd "$cmd" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:("This runs bazel clean --expunge (" + $cmd + "). Bazel has no stale cache to clear this way -- it wipes the whole build/download cache and forces a full rebuild. Confirm this is really the fix, not a substitute for diagnosing the real error, before proceeding.")}}'; fi; }
